Package org.apache.turbine.services.localization

Class DateTimeFormatterService

java.lang.Object
org.apache.turbine.services.BaseInitable
org.apache.turbine.services.BaseService
org.apache.turbine.services.TurbineBaseService
org.apache.turbine.services.localization.DateTimeFormatterService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initable, DateTimeFormatterInterface, Service
public class DateTimeFormatterService extends TurbineBaseService implements DateTimeFormatterInterface
This service is used to format TemporalAccessor and map(String, DateTimeFormatter, Locale) (different flavors) objects into strings.

The methods may throw UnsupportedTemporalTypeException or DateTimeParseException, e.g. if the source and the target format do not match appropriately.

    • init

      public void init()
      Initialize the service.

      the dateTimeFormat from formatPattern is initialized with

      1. Locale: LocaleUtils.getDefaultLocale() is used by default. It could be overridden setting #USE_TURBINE_LOCALE_KEY to false, the the default Locale Locale.getDefault() is used.
      2. ZoneId: If #DATE_TIME_ZONEID_KEY is set this ZoneId is used else ZoneId.systemDefault().
      Specified by:
      init in interface Initable
